violations.explanation: The control is built from a raw Listener and Container instead of a standard button widget. It is not focusable and has no keyboard activation through Enter or Space. It also lacks the standard focus and hover handling of InkWell or IconButton. Screen reader activation works through Semantics.onTap. Keyboard and switch users who rely on focus traversal cannot reach or activate the button.

The send action fires on every pointer up, even when the pointer has moved off the button. It is not handled through the gesture arena, so it can also fire during scrolls or drags. Users with motor impairments cannot cancel an accidental press by sliding away from the button.

violations.affected_code: Semantics(button: true, label: 'Send message', onTap: widget.onSend, ...)
violations.explanation: The Semantics node does not expose an enabled state or focusability. Standard buttons report enabled or disabled and are focusable, so assistive technologies get incomplete state information for this control.
